judgments.reason: The span 'A 70-year-old man with castration-resistant prostate cancer and a 4-year history of diabetes mellitus' confirms castration-resistant prostate cancer but does not mention BRCA1 mutation or bone metastases, so it does not fully support the complete modifier as stated.

The span 'His prostate cancer, which had recurred with bone metastases after multiple radiotherapy and chemotherapy regimens, was found to harbor a BRCA1 mutation' explicitly documents both the BRCA1 mutation and bone metastases, directly supporting the modifier 'BRCA1-related castration-resistant prostate cancer with bone metastases'.
